text: Anything long enough time request belongs async endpoints. doclr_convert() wraps whole cycle — submit, poll spinner, collect — routes URLs local paths right endpoint : Drive steps want work : doclr_task_status() returns one-row tibble, makes easy watch several tasks : task fails raises doclr_error_task condition, one outlives timeout raises doclr_error_timeout — job still server, can call doclr_wait() id.

what: Reading tables and figures out of the result
title: Converting a document with doclr
text: Markdown readable form; JSON structured one. Ask want text read tree query: docling JSON tree carries texts, tables pictures collections. Tables arrive grids cells, can flatten data frame: Figures live tree$pictures. Ask embedded images want bytes rather placeholder:
code: doc <- doclr_convert(   "reports/quarterly.pdf",   doclr_options(to_formats = c("md", "json")) )  cat(as_markdown(doc))  tree <- as_json(doc) names(tree) tables <- tree$tables  table_to_df <- function(table) {   grid <- table$data$grid   rows <- lapply(grid, function(row) vapply(row, function(cell) cell$text, character(1)))   body <- do.call(rbind, rows[-1])   df <- as.data.frame(body, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)   names(df) <- rows[[1]]   df }  table_to_df(tables[[1]]) doc <- doclr_convert(   "reports/quarterly.pdf",   doclr_options(to_formats = "json", image_export_mode = "embedded") )  pictures <- as_json(doc)$pictures length(pictures)
